name: dsh-shtv
description: Inline Playwright MCP screenshot card + Live Browser sidebar panel for the DSH web GUI. Host serves workspace screenshots and a live frame pump feed over fenced loopback routes (/api/dsh-shtv); the client registers the tool.call.toolview card for mcp__browser__browser_take_screenshot and a native right-Sidebar Live Browser tab (ctx.sidebarRightTabs).
